member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Register(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.RegisterDto)
member.summary: Registers a new account as an Organiser or a Participant.
member.remarks: Expects name, email, password (minimum 8 characters) and role (Organiser or Participant). The password is hashed before it is stored. Only the two roles above are accepted.
member.response: Account created. Returns the new user's ID, name, email and role.
Invalid or missing data, or an unknown role.
An account with this email already exists.

member.summary: Logs in and starts a session.
member.remarks: Expects email and password. On success the server sets a session cookie (RaceDay.Session) that identifies the user and their role on every later request.
member.response: Logged in. Returns the user's ID, name, email and role.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Logout
member.summary: Logs out and ends the current session.

member.summary: Enrols the logged-in Participant in a category. Participants only.
member.remarks: No body is needed: the participant is identified from the session. The category must have space, and a participant can only hold one active enrolment per category. A previously cancelled enrolment is re-activated.
member.response: Enrolled. Returns the enrolment including its ID.

member.summary: Lists all enrolments made by the logged-in Participant. Participants only.

member.summary: Lists everyone enrolled in a category. Only the Organiser who owns the event may do this.
member.response: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own the event.

member.summary: Cancels an enrolment. Callable by the enrolled Participant or the Organiser who owns the event.
